caption: The drawing depicts a single small goblet or chalice centered on a plain, light-colored background. The goblet has a round bowl with a wide opening and is predominantly yellow in color with an orange-red rim and base. The body of the goblet features a green leafy branch and a pomegranate-like fruit in darker green and brown tones as decoration. The goblet is positioned on a short, rounded stem and a circular, green foot with a broad black base. The artist's signature, "C. Henqing," appears in small, neat text to the left of the goblet. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the drawing.
title: Pa. German Salt Cup
